args.sql_query: SELECT * FROM product_sales_by_region WHERE "pk_products 1 4_bronze_silver_id" IS NOT NULL AND "pk_sales_data 1 4_bronze_silver_id" IS NOT NULL LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_rows, COUNT("pk_stores 1 4_bronze_silver_id") as store_count, COUNT("pk_products 1 4_bronze_silver_id") as product_count, COUNT("pk_sales_data 1 4_bronze_silver_id") as sales_count FROM product_sales_by_region
SELECT * FROM product_sales_by_region WHERE "pk_sales_data 1 4_bronze_silver_id" IS NOT NULL LIMIT 10
SELECT column_name, data_type FROM (DESCRIBE SELECT * FROM product_sales_by_region)

WITH stores AS (
    SELECT 
        "pk_stores 1 4_bronze_silver_id" as store_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "pk_stores 1 4_bronze_silver_id") as row_num
    FROM product_sales_by_region 
    WHERE "pk_stores 1 4_bronze_silver_id" IS NOT NULL
),
products AS (
    SELECT 
        "pk_products 1 4_bronze_silver_id" as product_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "pk_products 1 4_bronze_silver_id") as row_num
    FROM product_sales_by_region 
    WHERE "pk_products 1 4_bronze_silver_id" IS NOT NULL
),
sales AS (
    SELECT 
        "pk_sales_data 1 4_bronze_silver_id" as sales_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "pk_sales_data 1 4_bronze_silver_id") as row_num
    FROM product_sales_by_region 
    WHERE "pk_sales_data 1 4_bronze_silver_id" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stores) as store_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products) as product_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales) as sales_count

WITH sales_data AS (
    SELECT 
        s.store_id,
        s.product_id,
        s.category,
        s.total_amount as revenue,
        st.region
    FROM read_csv_auto('C:\Users\amarkkumar\Downloads\Amar_usecase\amar_case\data\landing\sales_data 1 4.csv') s
    JOIN read_csv_auto('C:\Users\amarkkumar\Downloads\Amar_usecase\amar_case\data\landing\stores 1 4.csv') st
    ON s.store_id = st.store_id
),
category_region_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        category,
        SUM(revenue) as total_revenue,
        COUNT(*) as transaction_count
    FROM sales_data
    GROUP BY region, category
),
regional_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        SUM(total_revenue) as region_total_revenue
    FROM category_region_revenue
    GROUP BY region
),
ranked_categories AS (
    SELECT 
        crr.region,
        crr.category,
        crr.total_revenue,
        crr.transaction_count,
        rt.region_total_revenue,
        ROUND(100.0 * crr.total_revenue / rt.region_total_revenue, 2) as pct_of_regional_revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY crr.region ORDER BY crr.total_revenue DESC) as rank_in_region
    FROM category_region_revenue crr
    JOIN regional_totals rt ON crr.region = rt.region
)
SELECT 
    region,
    category,
    ROUND(total_revenue, 2) as total_revenue,
    transaction_count,
    ROUND(region_total_revenue, 2) as region_total_revenue,
    pct_of_regional_revenue,
    rank_in_region
FROM ranked_categories
ORDER BY region, rank_in_region

WITH sales_data AS (
    SELECT 
        s.store_id,
        s.product_id,
        -- Normalize category names to handle inconsistent casing and variations
        CASE 
            WHEN UPPER(s.category) IN ('ELECTRONICS', 'ELECTRONIC', 'ELEC.') THEN 'Electronics'
            WHEN UPPER(s.category) IN ('BEAUTY', 'COSMETICS') THEN 'Beauty'
            WHEN UPPER(s.category) IN ('SPORTS', 'SPORT', 'SPORTING GOODS') THEN 'Sports'
            WHEN UPPER(s.category) IN ('APPAREL', 'CLOTHING') THEN 'Apparel'
            WHEN UPPER(s.category) IN ('HOME & KITCHEN', 'HOME') THEN 'Home & Kitchen'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END as category,
        s.total_amount as revenue,
        st.region
    FROM read_csv_auto('C:\Users\amarkkumar\Downloads\Amar_usecase\amar_case\data\landing\sales_data 1 4.csv') s
    JOIN read_csv_auto('C:\Users\amarkkumar\Downloads\Amar_usecase\amar_case\data\landing\stores 1 4.csv') st
    ON s.store_id = st.store_id
),
category_region_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        category,
        SUM(revenue) as total_revenue,
        COUNT(*) as transaction_count
    FROM sales_data
    GROUP BY region, category
),
regional_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        SUM(total_revenue) as region_total_revenue
    FROM category_region_revenue
    GROUP BY region
),
ranked_categories AS (
    SELECT 
        crr.region,
        crr.category,
        crr.total_revenue,
        crr.transaction_count,
        rt.region_total_revenue,
        ROUND(100.0 * crr.total_revenue / rt.region_total_revenue, 2) as pct_of_regional_revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY crr.region ORDER BY crr.total_revenue DESC) as rank_in_region,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY crr.total_revenue DESC) as overall_rank
    FROM category_region_revenue crr
    JOIN regional_totals rt ON crr.region = rt.region
),
top_categories_per_region AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        category as top_category,
        ROUND(total_revenue, 2) as top_category_revenue,
        transaction_count as top_category_transactions,
        ROUND(region_total_revenue, 2) as region_total_revenue,
        pct_of_regional_revenue as top_category_pct_share
    FROM ranked_categories
    WHERE rank_in_region = 1
)
SELECT 
    rc.region,
    rc.category,
    ROUND(rc.total_revenue, 2) as total_revenue,
    rc.transaction_count,
    ROUND(rc.region_total_revenue, 2) as region_total_revenue,
    rc.pct_of_regional_revenue,
    rc.rank_in_region,
    CASE WHEN rc.rank_in_region = 1 THEN 'TOP PERFORMER' ELSE '' END as top_performer_flag
FROM ranked_categories rc
ORDER BY rc.region, rc.rank_in_region
